children: ONEOK entered into Amendment No. 1 to its Equity Distribution Agreement to maintain its at-the-market equity offering program of up to $1.0 billion following recent reorganization transactions. The amendment, with BofA Securities as sales agent and principal and Bank of America as forward purchaser, updates terms and transfers obligations from Legacy ONEOK to ONEOK. The program allows ONEOK to sell common stock, including via forward sales, to support general corporate purposes and financial flexibility.
: Amended at-the-market equity distribution program with forward sale option
: BofA Securities and Bank of America
